title: I2S: microphones, DACs, and digital audio

spans.text: I2S carries digital audio using bit clock (BCLK), word select (WS/LRCLK), and data lines. It connects digital microphones, DACs, and audio codecs; it is not UART or I2C. Sample rate, slot width, and mono/stereo format must match.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Pin routing and I2S APIs vary by ESP32 family and framework version. Treat the snippet as configuration guidance and verify clock and buffer limits in the datasheet.
